newsitem.title: USA: ITT Automotive names new Europe chairman.
newsitem.headline: ITT Automotive names new Europe chairman.

text.p: ITT Automotive, a unit of ITT Industries Inc, said Friday it named Jurgen Geissinger as management board chairman for ITT Automotive Europe GmbH, effective February 1.
As part of the new role, Geissinger, 38, will assume responsibility for ITT Automotive's Brake & Chassis Systems worldwide product group. He succeeds Klaus Lederer, who resigned recently.
Geissinger was previously general manager of electronic brake systems, based in Frankfurt, Germany.
ITT Automotive Europe also appointed Bernd Herbst, 46, as management board member in charge of sales. He succeeds Klaus Troster, who retired on December 31.
